name: Teknora Kanban
author: Juliana Rodrigues Guimarães

sections.description:
Teknora Kanban adds a visual project management board to WordPress with drag-and-drop task management.

Features:
* Drag and drop Kanban board
* Project management
* Task management
* Task archive
* Task delete
* Filters and search
* KPI indicators

Use the shortcode below on any page:

[teknora_kanban]
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/teknora-kanban directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Create a page and insert the shortcode [teknora_kanban].
  4. Open the page while logged in with a user that can edit posts.
sections.faq:
Does it support multiple projects?

Yes.

Can I archive tasks?

Yes.

Can I delete tasks?

Yes.
